The change introduces the llvm.aarch64.sve.prf intrinsic, TableGen selection patterns for byte/halfword/word/doubleword predicate widths and indexed addresses, and SelectionDAG logic that derives a memory vector type from the SVE prefetch predicate because the intrinsic node is not itself a MemSDNode. It also adds llc tests validating emitted SVE prefetch instructions and address-offset encodings.

Summary: This commit changes AArch64 GlobalISel copy selection for subregister copies. It removes an intermediate copy into a target-bank register class and instead constructs the subregister COPY directly from the original source register. It also adds register-bank minimum-size classification and updates/adds MIR tests to expect the shorter copy sequences.
Changed symbols: getMinSizeForRegBank; selectCopy; selectSubregisterCopy; test_128_fpr_truncation
Behavioral change: selectSubregisterCopy no longer builds an intermediate COPY to a temporary register before creating the subregister COPY; the final COPY now uses SrcReg directly with the selected subregister.; The shown selectCopy path no longer obtains a source-sized destination-bank register class and no longer invokes the removed intermediate-copy form of selectSubregisterCopy.; A new getMinSizeForRegBank helper defines minimum representable sizes of 32 bits for the AArch64 GPR bank and 8 bits for the FPR bank.; GlobalISel MIR expectations are changed from multi-copy 64-bit-to-32-bit sequences to direct subregister-copy sequences.

Reproducer link: The added and modified tests exercise AArch64 GlobalISel instruction selection and subregister COPY formation.; No retrieved test uses XRay, patchable-function-entry metadata, emitXRayTable, MCSymbolRefExpr, or MC symbol references.

Summary: This commit changes AArch64 SelectionDAG comparison lowering so a compare-against-zero of an integer AND is formed as an AArch64 ANDS node whose value and condition-code result can be shared. It also teaches shift-amount selection to recognize ANDS as equivalent to AND for immediate-mask matching, with tests updated to expect ANDS rather than a separate AND plus TST.
Changed symbols: emitComparison; AArch64DAGToDAGISel::tryShiftAmountMod; isOpcWithIntImmediate; test_func_i32_two_uses; test_func_i64_one_use; fshl_i32; n6_fshl
Behavioral change: emitComparison now replaces an ISD::AND used in a signed compare-to-zero with a newly created AArch64ISD::ANDS node and returns its condition-code result, allowing the integer result and flags to share one instruction.; emitComparison reuses the condition-code result when its left-hand side is already an AArch64ISD::ANDS node.; tryShiftAmountMod now accepts either ISD::AND or AArch64ISD::ANDS as a masked immediate shift amount.; AArch64 code generation for affected patterns changes from separate AND/TST sequences to ANDS-based sequences.
Assertion or trace link: AArch64; assembly printer; llvm::MCSymbolRefExpr::create; llvm::AsmPrinter::emitXRayTable; MCSymbolRefExpr; Symbol assertion
Reproducer link: The retrieved tests exercise ordinary AArch64 integer AND/compare, funnel-shift, and shift-mask lowering.; No retrieved hunk contains XRay instrumentation, patchable-function-entry metadata, XRay table emission, MC symbol creation, or the reduced crash reproducer.
Pass or subsystem link: AArch64 SelectionDAG instruction selection and lowering; not AArch64AsmPrinter; not CodeGen AsmPrinter emitXRayTable; not MC expression or symbol-reference handling

Summary: This commit changes AArch64 SelectionDAG comparison lowering so a compare-against-zero of an integer AND is formed as an AArch64 ANDS node whose value and condition-code result can be shared. It also teaches shift-amount selection to recognize ANDS as equivalent to AND for immediate-mask matching, with tests updated to expect ANDS rather than a separate AND plus TST.
Changed symbols: emitComparison; AArch64DAGToDAGISel::tryShiftAmountMod; isOpcWithIntImmediate; test_func_i32_two_uses; test_func_i64_one_use; fshl_i32; n6_fshl
Behavioral change: emitComparison now replaces an ISD::AND used in a signed compare-to-zero with a newly created AArch64ISD::ANDS node and returns its condition-code result, allowing the integer result and flags to share one instruction.; emitComparison reuses the condition-code result when its left-hand side is already an AArch64ISD::ANDS node.; tryShiftAmountMod now accepts either ISD::AND or AArch64ISD::ANDS as a masked immediate shift amount.; AArch64 code generation for affected patterns changes from separate AND/TST sequences to ANDS-based sequences.
Assertion or trace link: AArch64; assembly printer; llvm::MCSymbolRefExpr::create; llvm::AsmPrinter::emitXRayTable; MCSymbolRefExpr; Symbol assertion
Reproducer link: The retrieved tests exercise ordinary AArch64 integer AND/compare, funnel-shift, and shift-mask lowering.; No retrieved hunk contains XRay instrumentation, patchable-function-entry metadata, XRay table emission, MC symbol creation, or the reduced crash reproducer.

Summary: Adds initial AArch64 SVE support for floating-point scalable-vector SPLAT_VECTOR lowering. The change makes SPLAT_VECTOR custom-lowered for legal floating-point scalable vector types, funnels integer and floating-point scalar inputs through AArch64ISD::DUP construction, adds SVE DUP instruction-selection patterns for f16/f32/f64 values and zero constants, marks generic TableGen Pseudo instructions as pseudos, and extends the AArch64 SVE vector-splat code-generation test.
Changed symbols: AArch64TargetLowering::AArch64TargetLowering; AArch64TargetLowering::LowerSPLAT_VECTOR; AArch64ISD::DUP; AArch64dup; Pseudo; llvm/test/CodeGen/AArch64/sve-vector-splat.ll
Behavioral change: Legal floating-point scalable vector types now use custom ISD::SPLAT_VECTOR lowering on AArch64.; LowerSPLAT_VECTOR no longer returns immediately in integer scalar cases; it normalizes i8/i16/i32 inputs to i32 and i64 inputs to i64, then emits a common AArch64ISD::DUP node.; New SVE instruction-selection patterns lower floating scalar DUPs to DUP_ZZI_H/S/D forms and recognize zero floating-point splats.; The generic TableGen Pseudo class now sets isPseudo = 1, affecting generated metadata for instructions declared through that class.
Assertion or trace link: AArch64; assembly printer
Reproducer link: The retrieved change and its test cover scalable-vector splats, not XRay patchable-function-entry metadata or XRay table generation.; No retrieved hunk creates, stores, lowers, or references MCSymbolRefExpr, MCSymbol, XRay instrumentation, or patchable-function-entry metadata.
Pass or subsystem link: AArch64 SelectionDAG lowering; AArch64 SVE TableGen instruction selection; AArch64 code-generation tests

However, the observed failure is MCSymbolRefExpr::create asserting that a Symbol is present while AsmPrinter::emitXRayTable emits XRay metadata. The retrieved hunks modify only vector SPLAT_VECTOR lowering, SVE DUP patterns, pseudo instruction metadata, and SVE tests; they do not modify AArch64AsmPrinter, emitXRayTable, MC expression/symbol handling, or patchable-function-entry/XRay lowering. Therefore the available evidence does not establish a plausible direct causal path to the assertion.
